conviction_note: Most of Q3 revenue is already public (July 8.5 + Aug 19.3 MEUR) and Gofore gives no numeric guidance, so the release adds September sales, Q3 adjusted EBITA against a single analyst's bar (Inderes 4.2 MEUR / 8.5%) and the market commentary. The only lean is a mild margin-downside inference: 2026 quarters have run about 0.6 pt below 2025 like-for-like, Huld and Esentri dilute the mix, and hiring ran ahead of revenue in August. Finnish peers' weak Q3s are a proxy. abs_move is set from this name's own report-day moves (+1.4, +5.5, -11.6, +5.4) and its thin turnover; p_up is 47 because the lean is inference against a one-analyst bar. The findings sum (-0.6) and the scaled number (-0.33) agree in sign and are both small.

already_public.what: July 2026 net sales 8.5 (5.8) MEUR, published in the H1 report; utilisation 'at a good level'
August 2026 net sales 19.3 (14.7) MEUR, Finnish organic growth +4%, 1,879 employees, 48 new starters; PD&TD divestment closed 1 Sep (LTM sales 8.2 MEUR, 107 people leave from September)
Expected capital gain of about 0.5 MEUR on the PD&TD sale to CoE Group, booked at closing (Q3)
KEHA Centre framework wins: at least 33 MEUR (first package) plus at least 10 MEUR (second package) over six years; inside-information releases
Gofore gives no numeric guidance on net sales or profitability ('Gofore does not provide guidance on the net sales or profitability for the financial year')

new_in_release.expect: September net sales: about 21.3-21.6 MEUR (Sept 2025 20.7 incl. Huld, minus about 0.7 divested, plus Esentri about 1.0, plus 2-3% organic), so Q3 sales of about 49.1-49.4 against Inderes' 49.1. In line to marginally above.

Q3 adjusted EBITA: I expect slightly below Inderes' 4.2 MEUR (about 4.0-4.1), from the 2026 margin trend running below 2025, mix dilution and hiring ahead of revenue. This is the line the stock trades on; Q1'26 fell 11.6% and Q2'26 rose 5.4% on it.
None. The company gives no numeric guidance. The market-outlook text may firm (Finnish economy, defence, KEHA backlog) or stay cautious on the public sector. Direction unknown.
PD&TD capital gain of about 0.5 MEUR in reported EBIT, presumably excluded from adjusted EBITA. Neutral.

bar: Inderes Q3'26 preview (Joni Grönqvist, 2026-10-20): net sales 49.1 MEUR, organic growth 3.1%, adjusted EBITA 4.2 MEUR (8.5%), EBIT 3.2, adjusted EPS 0.16. The consensus column is empty, so this is a single-analyst bar: https://www.inderes.se/analyst-comments/gofore-q326-forhandskommentar-stark-tillvaxt-och-stabil-lonsamhet (Danish copy: https://www.inderes.dk/analyst-comments/gofore-q326-preview-staerk-vaekst-og-stabil-rentabilitet). It is one source, not two agreeing ones, so every finding is capped small.
session_check: bmo. The H1 report states 'Gofore's next interim report will be the Q3 Interim Report on 27 October 2026' (https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=b4556633584167eacf92f5287412fd7f0&lang=en&src=listed). Gofore's last three scheduled reports went out before the 10:00 EET Helsinki open: FY25 on 2026-02-25 at 07:40 CET, Q1'26 on 2026-04-29 at 07:45 CEST and H1'26 on 2026-08-18 at 08:00 CEST (09:00 EEST), all per the Nasdaq Nordic feed (https://api.news.eu.nasdaq.com/news/query.action?type=json&freeText=Gofore&globalGroup=exchangeNotice&globalName=NordicAllMarkets). The exact time for 27 Oct was not found, so this rests on the pattern rather than a timestamp.
positioning_check: Finanssivalvonta register read 2026-10-22: no disclosed net short position at or above 0.5% (https://www.finanssivalvonta.fi/api/shortselling/datatable/current). This is a truncated zero (anchor_covered false), so there is no positioning anchor and priced_lean_pct (-0.41) is just the run-up. Building or covering is not knowable. findings.finding: Q3 adjusted EBITA likely lands slightly below Inderes' 4.2 MEUR (8.5%). Like-for-like 2026 margins are running below 2025 (Q1'26 about 7.3% vs Q1'25 8.0%, derived from the H1 table). Q3'26 carries three months of lower-margin Huld plus Esentri against one month of Huld in Q3'25 (8.7%). August's 48 new starters put cost ahead of billing. Inderes itself flags that acquisition cost synergies are realising more slowly than expected.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Report days where the margin line surprised: Q1'26 (2026-04-29) -11.58%, H1'26 'adjusted EBITA more than tripled' (2026-08-18) +5.42%, FY25 (2026-02-25, Q4 adj. EBITA 14.0%) +5.50%, Q3'25 (2025-10-23) +1.40%. Closes from Yahoo GOFORE.HE.
findings.original_quote: Inderes (Finnish original, quoted on the Inderes forum 2026-10-20): 'Kannattavuuden ennustamme säilyneen pitkälti vertailukauden tasolla, mikä on sektorin kontekstissa hyvä, mutta yhtiölle heikko taso.' ('We forecast profitability to have stayed largely at the comparison-period level, which is good in the sector context but a weak level for the company.')
findings.why_not_priced: The only published bar sits at 8.5%, close to Q3'25's 8.7%. It does not carry the -0.6 pt like-for-like gap Q1'26 showed. Had the market priced a margin slip, the stock would not have run up 8.2% in 20 days into the print, and the bar would sit nearer 8%. It is an inference from company figures, not a disclosed number, hence the small size.
findings.independence: Inderes' own preview notes slower-than-expected acquisition cost synergies and growth investments weighing on the margin (https://www.inderes.se/analyst-comments/gofore-q326-forhandskommentar-stark-tillvaxt-och-stabil-lonsamhet). The H1 report says 'targeted growth investments will impact profitability in the short term' (same Nasdaq URL).

findings.finding: September revenue, the only unreported month of Q3, should come in about 21.3-21.6 MEUR on Gofore's own August data. That is in line to fractionally above the roughly 21.2 Inderes' 49.1 MEUR implies.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Monthly business reviews move this stock 3-5% on their own: August review (2026-09-11) +5.10%, then -3.68% the next session; June review (2026-07-13) +3.19%. Revenue surprises are usually absorbed at the monthly release, not on report day.
findings.why_not_priced: July and August are public and priced, so only September is new. Inderes notes headcount 'exceeded our expectation', which could support late-Q3 billing. Sept 2026 and Sept 2025 both had 22 working days, and Sept 2025 already included Huld (3.6 MEUR), per the Q3'25 report (https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=b7da67572e1b0f598016a0c329114ba25&lang=en&src=listed). The edge is tiny.
findings.independence: Inderes preview: 'personalstyrka i augusti överträffade vår förväntning, vilket kan stödja faktureringen i slutet av Q3' (https://www.inderes.se/analyst-comments/gofore-q326-forhandskommentar-stark-tillvaxt-och-stabil-lonsamhet).

findings.finding: Finnish IT-services peers that reported Q3 the week before were weak or flagged Finland as the hardest market. Vincit: Q3 revenue -12.3%, adj. EBITA -1.7%, projects slow to start after the summer holidays. Witted: Finnish revenue -2.2%. Knowit: 'Finland has the most challenging market situation'. This argues for some September/utilisation risk at Gofore. Gofore's own August Finnish organic +4% contradicts it, so it is sized as a weak proxy.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No direct history. Gofore's reports have not tracked peer prints; the Q1'26 -11.6% came on its own margin.
findings.original_quote: Witted (Finnish-only release, 2026-10-21): 'Suomessa ohjelmistokehitysliiketoimintamme on kasvanut myös kolmannella neljänneksellä, mutta muutosjohtamisen liiketoiminnan hidastuminen painoi koko Suomen liikevaihdon 2,2 %:n laskuun.' ('In Finland our software development business also grew in Q3, but the slowdown in change management pushed total Finnish revenue down 2.2%.') https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=b781c52516e54ec1c7722a04f5fad1403&lang=fi&src=listed
findings.why_not_priced: Gofore rose into these releases (run-up 5d +4.1%, 20d +8.2%), so the price did not mark Gofore down on peer weakness. Gofore is mostly public sector, so transmission from private-sector peers is a hypothesis, and that keeps this small.
findings.independence: Knowit Q3 (2026-10-23): 'Finland has the most challenging market situation as a result of a weaker economic climate than the rest of the Nordics' (https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=b5c9055a2bb84e173a62665f53af5f707&lang=en&src=listed). Witted (Finnish URL above).

findings.finding: Gofore ranked first on all three areas of KEHA Centre's first 'extensive development' framework, worth at least 33 MEUR to Gofore, and on 'Tuotealustat ja ratkaisut', at least 10 MEUR, in the second. Six-year contracts, announced 2026-10-22. They give the release a firm order-intake and backlog narrative for the outlook commentary.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock rose 5.93% on the announcement day (2026-10-22), then gave back 1.8% and 2.5% over the next two sessions to 11.62. Contract wins move it on announcement, not later.
findings.original_quote: Inderes (2026-10-23, quoted on the Inderes forum): 'Vaikka sopimus on arviomme mukaan aikaisempia suurempi, toimii se ensisijaisesti tärkeänä peruskuorman rakentajana eikä aiheuta välittömiä muutospaineita ennusteisiimme.' ('Although the contract is in our view larger than earlier ones, it mainly builds base load and puts no immediate pressure on our forecasts.')
findings.why_not_priced: It is largely priced: a +5.9% day followed by a fade. What is left is how management frames it in the outlook. It is a renewal of an existing customer (the 2020 KEHA deal was 40-60 MEUR over six years), not incremental volume.
findings.independence: Inderes forum post by the analyst, 2026-10-23, with the full award table (https://forum.inderes.com/t/5296/1274).

findings.finding: On 2026-10-15 an unusual closing auction of about 50k shares crossed: Yahoo volume 79,301 against a typical 7-15k. The stock closed at the day's high, 11.42 (+3.4%), a week before the KEHA news. It suggests a single buyer accumulating ahead of the print.
findings.original_quote: 'Goforella tänään mielenkiintoinen reilun 50.000 osakkeen loppuhuutokauppa. Kurssikin nousi heittämällä päivän ylimpään 11,42 e.' ('Gofore had an interesting closing auction of just over 50,000 shares today. The price jumped to the day's high, 11.42 EUR.')
findings.why_not_priced: It is already in the run-up. Buyer and seller are unknown, and on a $187k/day name one block can be a fund rebalance, so the size is negligible.

findings.finding: The PD&TD sale to CoE Group closed 1 September 2026, with a guided capital gain of about 0.5 MEUR in Q3 reported EBIT. It is presumably excluded from adjusted EBITA, and it trims lower-gross-margin revenue from September.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced. The gain was guided in August, and Inderes' EBIT of 3.2 presumably already reflects it.
findings.independence: August business review confirms the closing on 1 September (https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=b28bbe4f2af2ec252acbb4771a70ff40b&lang=en&src=listed).

outside_window.finding: In the KEHA award decision the buyer remarked on Gofore's 'exceptionally low-seeming price' and asked the company to justify it; price weighed 40% in the tender. This is a margin question for the 2027+ run-rate of a contract that is a renewal, and it does not resolve in this session. It may colour the call, and the stock faded 4.3% in the two sessions after it was posted.

rejected_candidates.detail: The release itself says the withdrawal is due only to the BLC Turva acquisition and that the underlying business 'developed as planned', so it is not a demand read-through.

baseline_tension: The run-up (+8.2% over 20 days, +4.1% over 5, mostly the KEHA spike) and the -0.41 run-up-only lean point mildly down. My small margin-downside lean agrees with them, so it is partly priced and stays small; there is no short register anchor to beat.
language_note: The Inderes forum (Finnish) carried the analyst's remark that the KEHA award decision noted Gofore's 'poikkeuksellisen alhaiselta vaikuttanut hinta' (exceptionally low-seeming price) and asked for a justification. No English source carries this.
The forum also carried the full KEHA ranking table and the 2026-10-15 50k-share closing auction; neither is in the English releases.
Witted's Q3 release is Finnish-only and gave the Finnish-market peer data point (Finland revenue -2.2%).
Gofore's own filings and the Inderes preview were fully available in English and Swedish/Danish translation, so the filing layer added nothing local.
lessons_applied: A finding about a number already told is worth 0: the September revenue finding was cut from +0.3 to +0.2, because July and August, about 57% of Q3 revenue, are public and only September is new.
A narrow proxy and a single-analyst bar both pull p_up toward 50: p_up moved from 46 to 47, so expected_move went from -0.44 to -0.33.
'Too small about the move': abs_move_pct was kept at 5.5 rather than cut to the no-guidance 2.3% median, because profit is new and this name's own report days include -11.6%.
